product.title: Heavyweight Cotton Work Vest with Snap Closure
product.description: Inspired by classic workwear, this vest brings layered warmth and utility to any outing. Rugged cotton canvas feels substantial but never stiff, making it easy to move and bend as you wrangle leashes or logs by the fire. Three roomy pockets keep gloves, treats, or phone close by Tough snap closures make for quick changes—no stuck zippers Lined collar feels soft against your neck on cool mornings
